title: WARNER MUSIC CENTRAL EUROPE LAUNCHES WARNER RECORDS GERMANY, LED BY LEA LONDA

body_markdown:
###### *Under Londa’s leadership, the new frontline label sets its sights on a new era of growth and ambition*


**Berlin, September 1st 2026** – Warner Music Central Europe today announced the official launch of Warner Records Germany, establishing an elite frontline label powered by one of music industry’s most iconic global banners. Operating out of Berlin, the label is a bold statement of intent, bridging the uncompromising excellence of its legendary US heritage with the raw, cultural heart of the German market.


To lead the label, Lea Londa has been appointed Director of Warner Records Germany, reporting to Jean-Sebastien Permal, SVP of A&R for Central Europe and EMEA. As a 16-year industry executive, Londa has spent more than a decade at WM Central Europe, rising through the ranks from Media Manager through to Marketing Director.


She has spearheaded high-impact promotional campaigns across dance, rap, pop, and rock, working with global superstars such as Coldplay, Enya, Ed Sheeran, and Linkin Park.


Londa also has a strong track record with domestic talent. She orchestrated the campaign behind Udo Lindenberg x Apache 207’s “Komet”, which is the longest running No. 1 German single in history. Furthermore she has been an integral part of the support system behind the breakthrough of Provinz, one of Germany’s most influential bands for years, ran campaigns that led to multiple Gold and Platinum records for superstar Robin Schulz, as well as developing breakout talent MilleniumKid.


Her philosophy of long-term artist development and cultural relevance is already reflected in the label’s curated roster. Warner Records Germany champions a diverse, high-impact lineup including iconic legend Udo Lindenberg, Provinz, emerging artist Yasola, and versatile talent LINA. Together, these lighthouse artists exemplify the label’s commitment to providing both enduring superstars and next-generation visionaries with a permanent home.


Aaron Bay-Schuck, CEO & Co-Chairman, Warner Records, and Tom Corson, COO & Co-Chairman, Warner Records & COO, WMG, comments: “Warner Records has always been a label built around iconic, visionary artists. Launching Warner Records Germany reinforces our global commitment to championing creative talent, empowering the German team to discover, nurture, and elevate the next generation of artists both in Germany and on the world stage.”


Lea Londa, Director of Warner Records Germany, adds: “Bringing the iconic legacy of Warner Records to Germany is a pivotal moment, and I am grateful to both Niels and Seb for their trust in my vision to lead this new chapter. I am excited to shape this future with the artists I have worked closely with for years, and to welcome new talent into a true musical home. Together with the team, we will build a creative culture that makes Warner Records Germany a successful force in the market.”


Jean-Sebastien Permal, SVP of A&R, Warner Music Central Europe and EMEA, continues: “Launching Warner Records Germany is a defining step in our growth, and Lea was the clear choice to lead it. She has spent her career earning the trust of artists, and she brings a sharp point of view about what a modern frontline label should give them. Under her leadership from Berlin, Warner Records Germany will become a genuine home for artists at every stage of their careers.”


Niels Walboomers, President, Warner Music Central Europe, finishes: “Bringing the legendary Warner Records brand to Germany underscores our commitment to the region. We are building an elite, modern label model that puts artists first and drives domestic culture forward. I’m thrilled to support Lea and Seb as they lead this charge from the heart of Berlin.”
